prose: Zelda Williams is again asking fans to stop creating and circulating AI-generated videos of her late father, Robin Williams. Per Variety, this comes nearly a year after she last took to social media to ask people not to send her augmented content featuring the actor. The cached source was only the article's opening, so this summary reflects that limited text plus the headline's report of her telling fans to 'have some shame'.
highlights: Zelda Williams calls for an end to fan-made AI videos of Robin Williams
Variety: nearly a year since her previous plea against augmented content of her father
Headline quote: she told fans creating the videos to 'have some shame'
The cached source was only the opening lines; fuller detail is unverified
